notes: Asking price is shown with the label 'Price:' on detail pages (inside the status-list ul) and also displayed on search result listing cards. Revenue appears in the Financial Information section on detail pages under the label 'Revenue:' but is often blank/not disclosed per listing. Cash flow (SDE/owner benefit/discretionary earnings) is not present on any page; the Financial Information section shows 'Annual Net Income:' but this is net income, not SDE/cash flow, and it is also typically blank. City is shown under the label 'Area:' on the detail page status-list, and as a county/area name in the search results location span; there is no separate state field anywhere on the site — all listings appear to be in California but the state is never explicitly labeled or displayed.
